_comment: Example of a workload exposing several log files with custom error patterns. All listed paths are tailed concurrently; an unreadable path is skipped with a warning while the rest keep working. MONITORING_ERROR_PATTERNS uses the JSON array form because one pattern contains a comma. privileged:true is required for the writable bind to root-owned /var/log/workloads.
label: Sample multi-log gateway service
description: A workload with separate application and access logs, each monitored.
